{{Quote|Where were the ''Jedi'' when Lythian pirates killed your parents &hellip; and mine?|Alto Stratus, to Jabiimi Nationalists|<ref name="Republic 55" />}}
The '''Lythian pirate raids''' were a number of attacks done by<ref name="FF125" /> [[Lythian pirates]]<ref name="Republic 55" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] during the [[Great Peace of the Republic]].<ref name="FF125" /> During the raids, the pirates besieged small communities<ref name="db">{{DB|location|jabiim|Jabiim}}</ref> and killed many people, including [[Alto Stratus]]' [[Parent/Legends|parents]].<ref name="Republic 55" /> The [[Jabiimi]] [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] proved instrumental in driving off the pirates.<ref name="GaW" />

After the raids, Alto Stratus never forgot that neither the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] nor the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] traveled to Jabiim to eliminate the threat,<ref name="CSWE" /> and cited the past record of Republic apathy to fuel public support in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] during the [[Battle of Jabiim]].<ref name="db" />
